name: 共有相手とリンク設定の管理パネル
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Redesign ONE actual Lighthouse LH15-0011, sharing members and link-settings panel.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary for icon geometry, optical weight, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls: file thumbnail/name;2-members section; invite PERSON WITH PLUS glyph;2 circular member identities; right chevron at FAR RIGHT; link-settings section and two-line empty-link state. Focus source x0 y375 w1179 h785, no page header/Done. Image2 ORIGINAL photo for the small file thumbnail, preserve actual kitchen photo/crop. Image3 OUR MOCK secondary for Japanese content and locked typography only: fix its rough two-person glyph missing PLUS, crowded chevron near avatar and mint-filled members. Image4 approved style for white rounded material and forest-green primary action.
Exact Japanese UI:
"礼拝準備の写真.jpg"
"メンバー 2人"
member initials "佐" and "鈴"
"リンクの設定"
"閲覧用リンク"
"リンクはまだ作成されていません"
No added copy or changed count. Meiryo Regular14/24px filename, Meiryo Bold12/16px section labels, Regular12/16px empty-state lines and initials, tracking0. Preserve these source-defined roles, no20px giant headings.
Logical width390px compact panel. Top thumbnail36x36 and filename beside. Member count heading, next row invite person-plus then two white neutral-outlined member circles with佐/鈴, chevron at far right. Fine divider, link section label, fine divider, two existing empty-link lines. One white rounded panel, subtle neutral edge and soft shadow, no nested cards.
Accent decision: original blue add-member glyph is a real action; adapt it to small forest-green gradient circle #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white original person-plus shape. Source pink/purple member circles only distinguish identities; adapt to white fine outlines/readable slate initials as official member-chip rule, no mint. Other utilities slate#526173. Preserve thumbnail photo colors, no extra accent.
Pure#FFFFFF canvas and surfaces; ink#1D1D1D, supporting text#6E6E6E. Keep empty state, no create-link CTA invented. Original controls detail decisions override rough mock; preserve Japanese content/artwork. No whole app, English, watermark, new members, controls, metrics, IDs, labels or device. Static design candidate.
reviewNotes: 原図・写真原本・自作を実際に開き原図の細部を優先。生成を目視：人物追加のプラスを復元、山括弧を右端へ移動、メンバー2人と佐／鈴、未作成リンク、日本語全文を保持。招待操作は緑グラデーション、メンバーは白・中立の細枠へ変更、ミントなし。小さな写真の厳密同一性とMeiryoのメトリクスは未証明。所有者承認・編集性・実装未確認。
